title: Web Hosting Plans Renewal Counted Before a Domain Retry
content:
**Product:** Harborline Customer Accounts, for the customer's hosting plan on Web Hosting Plans when a domain retry top-up is worked out

**Which plan is counted.** The hosting plan the top-up counts is the customer's active hosting plan with auto-renew on when its next auto-renew attempt falls before the retry. Because every auto-renew charge in any category tries credit first, the top-up covers this charge in full when its next auto-renew attempt falls from today up to the day before the retry, which credit would otherwise pay first. Its attempt days are 7, 3 and 1 calendar days before its term end date, the hosting charter's first auto-renew attempt day with its retry days; the next attempt is the first of these that is today or later. Its charge is reduced by the account tier's hosting discount, the discount being the charge less the reduced charge rounded half up to the cent.

**Term rate.** The term rate of the top-up's plan renewal follows the term length the plan's new term will have, which is the term of a term change scheduled for the plan where one is scheduled and otherwise its current term length:

| New term | Charge counted |
|---|---|
| 36 months | the plan tier's regular 36-month monthly rate times 36 |
| 24 months | the plan tier's regular 24-month monthly rate times 24 |
| 1 month | the plan tier's 1-month monthly price, with no setup fee |
| 12 months | the plan tier's regular 12-month monthly rate times 12 |
| otherwise | no hosting charge is counted |

The charge so found enters the credit the retry needs.

**Hypothetical.** Term end 9 days from today: attempt days 2 days, 6 days and 8 days from today; the next attempt is in 2 days. With the retry 6 days away, the plan is counted.
